issue: Investigate why tests are flaky in CI

observations.detail: CI test flakiness root cause is shared mutable infrastructure without per-worker isolation. Four parallel test workers share Docker containers (PostgreSQL, Redis) and network ports. Serial local execution provides implicit isolation that masks the issue.

Four failure categories all trace to the same root cause: (1) DB unique constraint contention causes timeouts, (2) cross-worker FK violations cause unexpected 500s, (3) shared Redis connection pool exhaustion causes connection refused, (4) port conflicts cause socket hang up. Fix all four with per-worker isolation.

Chose documentation-only deliverable (RCA doc + testing tutorial update) since the issue is an investigation task. No code changes needed on master — the test infrastructure changes should be implemented by the Developer role per the squad routing rules.

Investigation issues per squad routing.md go to the Architect role. The deliverable is an analysis document, not a code fix. Implementation of recommended fixes would be a separate issue routed to Developer.

The master branch has no src/ directory or real test files. The test files referenced in the issue (UserService.test.ts, OrderController.test.ts, etc.) describe CI failures for a hypothetical application layer. The RCA document addresses the architectural patterns regardless of specific test file locations.
